targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_bin($__interval, s.time) AS time,
  s.orb_name,
  AVG(s.orb_score) AS value
FROM scores AS s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
  AND regexp_like(s.orb_name, '${orbs:regex}')
GROUP BY
  1,2
ORDER BY
  1 ASC, 2ASC

SELECT
  date_bin($__interval, s.time) AS time,
  s.orb_name,
  avg(s.lag_avg_us) AS value
FROM responsiveness AS s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
  AND regexp_like(s.orb_name, '${orbs:regex}')
GROUP BY
  1,2
ORDER BY
  1 ASC,2 ASC

SELECT
  s.orb_name,
  selector_last(s.orb_score, time)['value'] AS orb_score
FROM scores AS s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
  AND regexp_like(s.orb_name, '${orbs:regex}')
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  2 ASC
LIMIT 7

SELECT
  date_bin($__interval, s.time) AS time,
  s.orb_name,
  AVG(s.download_kbps) AS value
FROM speed AS s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
  AND regexp_like(s.orb_name, '${orbs:regex}')
GROUP BY
  1,2
ORDER BY
  1 ASC, 2ASC

SELECT
  date_bin($__interval, s.time) AS time,
  s.orb_name,
  AVG(s.upload_kbps) AS value
FROM speed AS s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
  AND regexp_like(s.orb_name, '${orbs:regex}')
GROUP BY
  1,2
ORDER BY
  1 ASC, 2ASC

SELECT
  s.orb_name,
  selector_last(s.orb_score, time)['value'] AS orb_score,
  selector_last(s.reliability_score, time)['value'] AS reliability_score,
  selector_last(s.responsiveness_score, time)['value'] AS responsiveness_score,
  selector_last(s.speed_score, time)['value'] AS speed_score
FROM scores AS s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
  AND regexp_like(s.orb_name, '${orbs:regex}')
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  1 ASC

SELECT
  date_bin($__interval, s.time) AS time,
  s.orb_name,
  AVG(s.ttfb_us) AS value
FROM web_responsiveness AS s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
  AND regexp_like(s.orb_name, '${orbs:regex}')
GROUP BY
  1,2
ORDER BY
  1 ASC, 2 ASC

SELECT
  date_bin($__interval, s.time) AS time,
  s.orb_name,
  AVG(s.packet_loss_pct) AS value
FROM responsiveness AS s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
  AND regexp_like(s.orb_name, '${orbs:regex}')
GROUP BY
  1,2
ORDER BY
  1 ASC, 2 ASC

SELECT
  s.orb_name,
  AVG(s.download_kbps) AS avg_download_kbps,
  AVG(s.upload_kbps) AS avg_upload_kbps
FROM speed AS s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
  AND regexp_like(s.orb_name, '${orbs:regex}')
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  1 ASC

SELECT
  s.orb_name,
  selector_last(network_name, s.time)['value'] as network_name,
  selector_last(bssid, s.time)['value'] as bssid,
  AVG(s.rssi_avg) AS rssi_avg,
  AVG(s.snr_avg) as snr_avg
FROM wifi_link AS s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
  AND regexp_like(s.orb_name, '${orbs:regex}')
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  1 ASC

SELECT
  date_bin($__interval, s.time) AS time,
  s.orb_name,
  AVG(s.rssi_avg) AS value
FROM wifi_link AS s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
  AND regexp_like(s.orb_name, '${orbs:regex}')
GROUP BY
  1,2
ORDER BY
  1 ASC, 2 ASC

SELECT
  date_bin($__interval, s.time) AS time,
  s.orb_name,
  AVG(s.cpu_avg_percent) AS value
FROM system_telemetry AS s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
  AND regexp_like(s.orb_name, '${orbs:regex}')
GROUP BY
  1,2
ORDER BY
  1 ASC, 2 ASC

SELECT
  date_bin($__interval, s.time) AS time,
  s.orb_name,
  AVG(s.mem_used_avg_bytes) AS "Bytes Used"
FROM system_telemetry AS s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
  AND regexp_like(s.orb_name, '${orbs:regex}')
GROUP BY
  1,2
ORDER BY
  1 ASC, 2 ASC

SELECT
  date_bin($__interval, s.time) AS time,
  s.orb_name,
  (AVG(s.mem_used_avg_bytes) / NULLIF(AVG(s.total_mem_bytes), 0)) * 100 AS "Percent Used"
FROM system_telemetry AS s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
  AND regexp_like(s.orb_name, '${orbs:regex}')
GROUP BY
  1,2
ORDER BY
  1 ASC, 2 ASC

SELECT
  date_bin($__interval, s.time) AS time,
  s.orb_name,
  AVG(s.disk_used_avg_bytes) AS "Bytes Used"
FROM system_telemetry AS s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
  AND regexp_like(s.orb_name, '${orbs:regex}')
GROUP BY
  1,2
ORDER BY
  1 ASC, 2 ASC

SELECT
  date_bin($__interval, s.time) AS time,
  s.orb_name,
  (AVG(s.disk_used_avg_bytes) / NULLIF(AVG(s.total_disk_bytes), 0)) * 100 AS "Percent Used"
FROM system_telemetry AS s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
  AND regexp_like(s.orb_name, '${orbs:regex}')
GROUP BY
  1,2
ORDER BY
  1 ASC, 2 ASC

SELECT
  s.orb_name,
  AVG(s.orb_cpu_avg_percent) AS orb_cpu_avg_percent,
  AVG(s.orb_mem_avg_bytes) AS orb_mem_avg_bytes,
  AVG(s.orb_disk_avg_bytes) AS orb_disk_avg_bytes
FROM system_telemetry AS s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.time)
  AND regexp_like(s.orb_name, '${orbs:regex}')
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  1 ASC
